summary: Iteration 18: tested the mobile-first website and the 'trading style of SFL' wording. One CRITICAL bug found and fixed: adviser_profile() passed Firm.model_dump() (key 'name') to regulatory_status(), which reads 'firm_name'. Because of that, regulatory_status was always an empty string, so the trading-style wording was MISSING from /api/start, /api/start/{code}, /api/invite/{code}, /api/presentation, /api/compliance-pack and the app Adviser tab. /api/privacy and /api/posting-plan were unaffected. After the one-line fix, the new suite tests/test_web_trading_style.py passes 14/14. Mobile web at 390x844: tapping start-check on /api/start/MARK-SFL?src=IG opens /auth?mode=register&code=MARK-SFL-IG with the code filled in. Register (new email, 10+ char password, privacy ticked) goes to /assessment. All 12 assessment steps complete and the report loads with the AI story. No horizontal overflow (scrollWidth 390, no off-screen elements). adviser-firm-info matches the exact wording, and so does the privacy screen. Desk login regression passes. Only failure: the page title is 'Safe > Sorry', not 'Safe > Sorry · Free family protection check'. app.json has web.output 'single', so +html.tsx is never used.

critical.issue: FIXED by testing agent: regulatory_status empty. server.py:353 regulatory_status(f.model_dump()) -> Firm has 'name' not 'firm_name' so function returned ''. Changed to regulatory_status({**f.model_dump(), 'firm_name': f.name}).

minor.issue: Reel titles still say 'Coming soon reel (27s) · post before launch' and 'Story (15s) · coming soon, link in bio'. Filenames are also still safe-sorry-coming-soon.mp4 and safe-sorry-story-coming-soon.mp4, and they appear on the posting plan (asset links). Not customer-facing, but out of line with the 'no Coming soon' change. Reference: /app/backend/reels.py:47-52

These older tests are out of date: test_reels.py TestRange hardcodes the old MP4 size 1813264 (re-rendered file is 2360813); test_iteration6 TestStoreLinkGating still expects 'Coming soon'. The full suite also flakes under xdist because tests share rate limits.

ui_bugs.issue: document.title is 'Safe > Sorry' on every route (/, /auth, /report, adviser tab), not 'Safe > Sorry · Free family protection check'. app/+html.tsx is ignored because app.json expo.web.output = 'single' (+html.tsx only applies to static/server output). The served index.html is Expo's default template, so the og:title, description, theme-color and viewport-fit meta tags are missing too. Fix: add /app/frontend/public/index.html with these head tags (SPA mode uses it), or set the title at runtime with expo-router/head <Head><title>…</title></Head> in app/_layout.tsx. Do not change app.json, it is protected.

action_items: Fix the web <title> and meta tags: create frontend/public/index.html (SPA template) with <title>Safe > Sorry · Free family protection check</title> plus the og/description/theme-color tags, or use expo-router/head in app/_layout.tsx. +html.tsx has no effect with web.output='single'.
Review the fix applied at server.py:353 (regulatory_status now receives firm_name). Consider making regulatory_status accept a Firm, or renaming keys, so the mismatch can't happen again.
